meta.disclosure: The Reading in the docstring was written before any cell ran and was not changed after the implementer had seen, before the code's first commit (47dbe06): two timing probes of one cell (segment A, noise, 50 dB-Hz, 20 s: R_B 0.491 +- 0.067; R_TA 1.001, 1.000, 1.000 at tau = 1, 10, 100 ms) and four diagnostic cells checking the machinery against s29 (segment A, noise, 60 dB-Hz, 20 s; R_B: D1 flat noise at s29's N0 0.950 +- 0.009, D4 flat at run 2's N0 0.927 +- 0.014, D3 shaped at the synthetic N0 0.898 +- 0.012, D2 shaped at run 2's N0, s33's own cell, 0.887 +- 0.012; R_TA 0.991-0.995 in all four). No design choice changed after them. While reading run 2's summary layout the implementer saw two of its front-end ratios (noise, 55 dB-Hz); no design choice depends on them.

status: written before E2 run 3 (P2c task 4, R-7); it decides only the R9 re-scope's conditional front-end range, through s34, never G3

e2_run2.label: analog_sd, n0_per_hz and line_excess_db only; run 2's front-end ratios are not read

design.construction: s28's E2 structure (review.s28_twin_pair_quantisation: make_cell, window_sums, errors, e2s_stats, write_ibyte) with R-7's six changes; the true front end's recursive AGC is gnssaudit.inject.pipeline._agc itself

seeds.bootstrap: E2's seed 7 on both segments (the registered statistic, not a draw)

fir.design: frequency sampling of sqrt(PSD) averaged into the FIR's bins (fs / 4097), centred, Hann-windowed (scipy.signal.windows.hann, symmetric), scaled to run 2's analog_sd per component

psd_check.ruling: T4e (25 Oct 2026), correcting P5: the Hann window's main lobe is 4 FIR bins (4 / N), so the FIR's resolution is 4 bins; the width follows from R-7's design, not from the measured PSD; the 1-bin mismatch is reported beside it

design.stop_rule: a cell stops at the first checkpoint where SE(R_B) and SE(R_TA) at every tau are all <= 0.02, otherwise at 60 s (controller ruling, 25 Oct 2026); the stationary R_TA stops nothing

seeds.compared: SeedSequence states (entropy padded to four words)

self_check.agc: the true front end calls gnssaudit.inject.pipeline._agc itself: no re-implementation

model_limits: Gaussian analog noise from a 4 097-tap Hann-windowed FIR: lines narrower than about 30 kHz (the window's 4-bin main lobe) are smeared by the model, on segment B those at -5.42, -5.59 and +4.58 MHz (segments.*.psd_match_1bin); s34's acceptance judges whether that matters

the target is the 3-bit recording's PSD, which already holds quantisation noise and the real satellites, so the requantised synthetic recording is flatter than the real one (segments.*.line_excess_db_synthetic against line_excess_db_run2)
the jammer and the ghost are added to the analog digitally, as E2 adds them to the recording; they do not pass the front end's filter

one ghost per segment (s28's PRN 32, 1 510 Hz, 45 dB-Hz), correlated at the native rate on its exact waveform; run 3 has two ghosts per segment, chosen by its survey, tracked by GNSS-SDR after a 4x decimation
the true front end's AGC is mode B's recursion holding the clean analog power (ruling T4b), not a measured AGC law
the bootstrap's seed 7 is shared by both segments: it is the registered statistic, not a simulated draw
